public class cf3082C {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner f = new Scanner(System.in);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(f.nextLine());
        int w = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        f.close();

        int[] digits = makeDigits(m, w);
        boolean works = isStable(digits, w);

        System.out.println(works ? "YES" : "NO");
    }

    private static int[] makeDigits(int r, int w) {
        int l = (int) (Math.log(r) / Math.log(w));
        int[] digits = new int[l + 2];
        int e = l;
        while (e >= 0) {
            double p = Math.pow(w, e);
            if (r - p >= 0) {
                digits[e] = (int) (r / p) % w;
            }
            e--;
        }
        return digits;
    }

    private static boolean isStable(int[] digits, int w) {
        for (int i = 0; i < digits.length - 1; i++) {
            if (digits[i] >= w) {
                digits[i] %= w;
                digits[i + 1]++;
            }
            if (!(digits[i] == 0 || digits[i] == 1)) {
                digits[i]++;
            }
            if (digits[i] >= w) {
                digits[i] %= w;
                digits[i + 1]++;
            }
        }
        for (int d : digits) {
            if (!(d == 0 || d == 1)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
